Try this: Try a mid-stride pose with wind-blown hair.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight black
hair blown back by wind stands full-length against a
white backdrop. She wears a pink floral sleeveless
top with a tie waist, a wide gold and cream cameo
belt, and a cream floral shoulder bag. Light-wash
flared jeans have embroidered floral details that run
down the legs. Her expression is calm and direct.
Soft, even studio light. Palette of dusty pink, sage,
and pale denim. Romantic and vintage, in the style
of a floral runway editorial.
